evidence_set: The abstract says depressive and psychotic symptoms resolve within 1 week. The Results do not support this for depression (scores fell over 2 weeks and stayed above controls through week 3) and only partly for the self-reported psychotic-symptom subscales (falling in week 1 and reaching control levels by the end of week 2). Analyses use 25–32 of the 56 participants, and the numbers assessed at weeks 3–5 are not given. Participants were admitted for neuroimaging studies lasting 2 or 5 weeks, so data after week 2 come only from the 5-week studies (study card: design, attrition, key finding 6 note).
